WHY CFAB?Behind every campaign, every product, and every growth milestone stands a team that takes ownership, moves fast, and delivers results. That is what cfab is all about.What looks like a strong fashion brand from the outside is powered by high performance, fast execution and people who work with real intensity to drive our growth every day.We’re looking for a Senior SEA Manager (m/f/d) to drive and scale our search performance across international markets. The role focuses on building, structuring and optimizing our SEA activities with a strong emphasis on performance, scalability and international growth. The goal is to establish efficient processes, unlock new growth potential and take ownership of one of the key performance channels.
DEIN IMPACT
• Own and scale our entire SEA setup across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads
• Manage Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube and GDN campaigns across performance and branding objectives
• Continuously improve our tracking setup using Google Tag Manager and Google Search Console
• Manage and optimize product feeds through Google Merchant Center and other relevant tools
• Develop and execute international SEA strategies across markets such as DACH, NL, FR, UK and the US
• Own campaign structures, execution, testing and continuous optimization
• Develop and test creatives together with our Creative, Data and Brand teams
• Identify new growth opportunities and develop tailored approaches for our international expansion
• Define budgets, manage key performance KPIs and provide regular reporting to leadership

WARUM DU ZU UNS PASST
• 4+ years of hands-on SEA experience, ideally in a fashion or D2C environment
• Strong expertise across the Google and Microsoft Ads ecosystem, especially Search, Shopping, Performance Max and YouTube
• Proven experience scaling paid search across multiple international markets
• Strong understanding of bid strategies, audience setups, testing frameworks and creative testing
• Experience with Google Tag Manager and Google Merchant Center
• Strong analytical mindset and a solid understanding of performance KPIs
• Experience with GA4, MMM or Looker Studio is a plus
• High level of ownership, initiative and speed of execution
• Clear and structured communication
• Fluent English, both written and spoken, German min. C1

WAS DICH BEI CFAB ERWARTET
• Permanent employment contract
• 31 vacation days
• Flexible trust-based working hours & up to 2 days of remote work per week
• Apple equipment (MacBook & iPhone)
• Paid team lunches three times per week
• Monthly flexible benefits (e.g. FitX membership or Probonio credit)
• Corporate benefits & exclusive discounts
• In-office manicure & barber appointments
• Monthly product vouchers
• Optional company car available after the probation period
• A personal birthday voucher
• Regular team events & celebrations
• Plenty of room for your ideas, ownership, and active co-creation

WAS UNS ANTREIBTOur growth is driven by people who set high standards, move things forward, and want to grow with the company. At cfab , you get the space to take ownership, develop your expertise, and make your impact visible.

READY TO CREATE WHAT’S NEXT?
Let’s make it happen.

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: AMHS Software Automation Engineer (m/w/d) Optimize the
heartbeat of our production. As an AMHS Software Engineer, you are the
mastermind behind the control system of our Automated Material
Handling System (AMHS). You ensure that millions of transport
movements mesh seamlessly, eliminate bottlenecks, and take the
efficiency of our production line to the next level. Tasks Your
Mission: Maximizing Performance Through Intelligent Control: System
tuning & KPI boost: You analyze transfer data and optimize system
performance to achieve capacity targets and minimize process
variability. Seamless integration: You ensure seamless communication
between the AMHS, production equipment, and higher-level control
systems. Innovation & Automation: You design KPI monitoring systems
and develop solutions to reduce manual intervention (manual loading)
to a minimum. Project Management & Cross-FAB Leadership: You lead
cross-site projects to reduce costs and increase productivity—from
planning through to go-live. Team Mentoring: You will lead and develop
a team of technicians and engineers, foster team spirit, and share
your knowledge. Lifecycle Management: You will validate new software
features, lead annual upgrades and retrofit projects, and assist in
the setup of new fab installations. Profile You are a proactive
teamplayer who combines in-depth technical knowledge with leadership
skills and a hands-on approach. Education: Master’s degree in
Industrial Engineering, Computer Science (IT), Systems Engineering,
Automation Engineering, or a related field. Expertise: In-depth
knowledge of optimization algorithms, Industrial Engineering (IE), and
information technology (C#, Java, Python, SQL, Oracle, MS-SQL, VBA)
Experience: Professional experience in the semiconductor industry is
required Methodology: You are proficient in applying problem-solving
methods such as FMEA, SPC, and 8D. Personality: A goal-oriented team
player with leadership potential who keeps a cool head even in a
dynamic, fast-paced environment. Language: Fluent in English (company
language). Basic communication skills in Mandarin or German is a plus.
Training: Available for on-the-job training in Taiwan, 9 to 12 months.
Location: Dresden, Germany. We offer Each journey starts with a first
step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the
unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden,
boost your career and put your true potential to the test. You will be
working in a fast paced, international startup environment whilst at
the same time having access to the experience, talent, and resources
of the largest and most advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the
world, TSMC. You have ample opportunities to learn about TSMC
Operations, Digital Transformation, and various advanced Facilities
related topics, both in Taiwan and other sites around the world.
Behind the world’s most advanced technology are real people with
real passion. Our success is fueled by our core values: Integrity,
Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust (ICIC). At ESMC we believe
in the power of inclusive leadership and passion. We demonstrate this
in our commitment to our people vision: create an inclusive
environment to inspire passion and enable the best in YOU. It is the
policy of ESMC to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all
persons regardless of age, color, ethnic and national origin,
citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion,
creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or
expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to
public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic
protected by federal, state or local law. Additional contact details
Please apply with your English resume. The ESMC recruiting team will
get in touch with you if your candidacy fits the hiring criteria.

WE ARE HIRING

Attorney-at-Law (m/f/d)
Commercial Law (North Macedonian Law) – Full-time or Part-time (min. 30h/week)
Location: initially Dresden, Germany / prospectively North Macedonia

WHO WE ARE

At RIEDIGER. legal | tax, we are not a traditional law firm with dusty files and dictation. We are an international, digitally oriented team of over 60 lawyers, tax experts, and accountants across Germany, the Czech Republic, and Poland, delivering outstanding work. We provide holistic, practical, and forward-looking advice to businesses—both legally and tax-wise.

A particular focus of our work lies in international and cross-border matters. Looking ahead, we plan to establish our own office in North Macedonia at a central location (e.g., Skopje, Bitola, Ohrid, or similar). We see significant economic and legal potential there and aim to develop this location deliberately and responsibly, closely connected to our existing offices.

WHAT WE OFFER

- A strategically exciting position with an international perspective
- Thorough onboarding and close support during the initial phase
- An interdisciplinary and appreciative working environment
- Clear structures, short decision-making processes, and genuine trust
- The opportunity to actively help build and shape a new office location
- Long-term collaboration with development prospects
- Permanent full-time or part-time employment (min. 30h/week)
- Predictable and flexible working hours with electronic time tracking
- A modern, well-equipped workplace
- A strong team culture: shared breakfasts, team events, and celebrations that strengthen cohesion
- Further training opportunities through seminars, training sessions, and individual programs, even during the probation period
- Free beverages, massages, parking options, and attractive additional benefits such as a monthly tax-free non-cash benefit of €50

WHAT YOU BRING

- You are a fully qualified lawyer (advokat) with solid knowledge of North Macedonian law, with a focus on commercial law
- You are a well-rounded commercial lawyer, not narrowly specialized
- Ideally, you have 2–3 years of professional experience (not mandatory)
- Business-fluent German or English skills (one of the two is required), as well as openness to using translation tools in daily work
- A high willingness to travel between Germany and North Macedonia

What matters most is that you are open to new legal and economic topics and are able to familiarize yourself with international and cross-border legal matters, particularly EU law, private international law, and relevant treaties. In addition, you bring economic and organizational understanding, as well as enthusiasm for building structures and contributing entrepreneurially.

You work in a highly independent and structured manner and demonstrate integrity, discretion, and loyalty toward the firm and our clients. You communicate effectively, even across distances.

You think long-term and entrepreneurially and are able to find creative solutions to complex economic and organizational challenges.

YOUR PERSPECTIVE

- Your place of work will initially be in Dresden, Germany, for 1–2 years.
- During this time, you will gain a comprehensive understanding of our working methods, client structure, firm culture, and interdisciplinary collaboration with our tax advisory team.
- At the same time, you will be regularly involved in project-based work in North Macedonia.
- The experience and structures gained in Germany will be gradually and transformatively transferred to North Macedonia and will play a key role in establishing and supporting a new office there.
- The exact location will be determined jointly and is intentionally kept open.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Providing legal advice to companies in a business-oriented environment
- Advising under North Macedonian law in the field of commercial law in its full scope, in particular: - Corporate law (including company formations, restructurings, and dissolutions)
- Drafting and negotiating contracts
- Supporting location decisions and investment projects
- Employment law matters
- Interfaces with tax law in close cooperation with our tax advisors
- Advising on funding opportunities and business-related regulatory frameworks
- Supporting and actively shaping business processes
- Building, maintaining, and developing client relationships
- In the long term: co-establishing and independently managing a law firm office in North Macedonia in close coordination with the Dresden office
- Regular professional and organizational exchange with the German team

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU

Are you interested in joining us on this journey of building a new office in North Macedonia and looking for a long-term position explicitly designed as an employment relationship? Then let’s talk.

Please send us your application documents, including your salary expectations and earliest possible start date, as a PDF to:
bewerbung@riediger-legal.com

Your local contacts:
Ms. Sophie Kahl | sophie.kahl@riediger-legal.com | +49 351 4383708 517
Ms. Marija Treneva | marija_treneva@yahoo.com

jobs.occupation: Electrical Engineer for Power Plant Applications (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
What You Will Do:

- Manage electrical engineering activities across the full project lifecycle, from concept and basic engineering through detailed design, installation, commissioning, and final acceptance
- Plan, design, and engineer electrical systems for power generation applications, ensuring solutions meet project requirements, customer expectations, and industry standards
- Develop electrical and control system concepts, including medium- and low-voltage systems, power distribution, protection systems, and control technologies
- Prepare and review electrical documentation such as circuit diagrams, technical specifications, load calculations, cable sizing, and protection coordination studies
- Ensure all engineering deliverables are accurate, compliant with regulations, and aligned with project timelines and quality standards
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (mechanical, process, and automation engineering) to integrate electrical systems into overall plant design effectively
- Support installation, commissioning, and testing activities, providing technical expertise, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring reliable operation of power generation equipment

What You Have (Key Skills/Experience Required):

- Several years of experience designing and engineering electrical systems within industrial, power generation, marine, or large-scale plant environments
- Strong expertise in medium- and low-voltage systems, electrical protection, power distribution, and international standards such as IEC and VDE
- Proven capability in performing electrical calculations, developing system designs, and managing comprehensive engineering documentation
- Proficiency in engineering tools such as EPLAN, AutoCAD, or comparable CAD software for electrical design and documentation.
- A structured, independent, and solution-driven approach, with strong analytical skills and attention to detail in complex engineering environments
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a willingness to travel internationally (~20%) to support global project execution.
- Proficiency both in English and in German (spoken and written)

What Will Put You Ahead (Preferred Skills):

- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
- Hands-on experience with automation and control systems for marine engines, including knowledge of bus communication (e.g., Modbus RTU/TCP, CANbus) and control engineering principles

What You Will Get

- Varied, responsible, and challenging tasks
- Excellent earning opportunities according to the Caterpillar compensation system
- 30 days of vacation
- Company pension plan
- Bicycle leasing / job ticket

Thinking of doing your PhD in the Life Sciences? The International PhD Programme (IPP) Mainz is offering talented scientists the chance to work on cutting edge research projects. As an IPP PhD student, you will join a community of exceptional scientists working on diverse topics ranging from how organisms age or how our DNA is repaired, to how epigenetics regulates cellular identity or neural memory. The research group of Anton Khmelinskii in collaboration with Jan Padeken offers the following PhD project:
The progressive deterioration of protein homeostasis (proteostasis) is a primary hallmark of aging. As organisms age, the functionality of the proteostasis network, comprised of molecular chaperones, the ubiquitin-proteasome system and autophagy, declines, leading to the accumulation of misfolded and aggregated proteins that compromise cellular viability. Proteostatic decline is not merely a consequence of aging but an early, causal event whereby loss of proteostasis precedes and predicts organismal decline, and its onset is sufficient to accelerate aging. Conversely, genetic or pharmacological enhancement of proteostasis network capacity can extend lifespan and suppresses age-related disease associated with protein misfolding across multiple model systems. These observations raise fundamental questions: what endogenous small molecules sustain proteostasis during aging, can their supplementation prevent neurodegenerative (and other protein folding diseases) and slow the aging process?

PhD project: Therapeutic applications of small molecule modulators of proteostasis

Organisms across all domains of life employ the accumulation of small organic osmolytes, which include molecules such as betaine and taurine, to mitigate proteotoxic stress. Recent work has also demonstrated anti-aging properties of this molecules, through yet unclear mechanisms. This project aims at dissecting the mode of action of different osmolytes using human cellular model systems and C. elegans as a model of organismal aging. We would like to address the following questions:

1. How do osmolytes affect cellular and organismal physiology?
2. Which types of stresses can be mitigated with exogenous osmolytes?
3. What types of protein misfolding pathologies (e.g., neurodegenerative diseases including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal dementia (FTD), Alzheimers's, Parkinson's, Huntington's) can be ameliorated with exogenous osmolytes?

The project is part of an ongoing collaboration between the Khmelinskii and Padeken groups, which gives you the opportunity to become an expert in a wide range of methods and experimental approaches. This includes transcriptomics, proteomics, cell and molecular biology, fluorescence microscopy and advanced high-throughput mutagenesis screening.

If you are interested in this project, please select Khmelinskii/Padeken as your group preference in the IPP application platform. Are you an ambitious scientist looking to push the boundaries of research while interacting with colleagues from multiple disciplines and cultures? Then joining the IPP is your opportunity to give your scientific career a flying start!
All you need is:

Master or equivalent

In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (29.8725 hours/week = 75%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for 1

Research associates (m/f/x) in scientific computing

The chair of numerical mathematics at the Ruhr University Bochum focuses on the development of efficient algorithms for solving problems in the natural and engineering sciences. A special emphasis is on hyperbolic conservation laws and high‑dimensional problems. We develop efficient numerical methods exploiting low‑rank tensor techniques and mixed‑precision algorithms. Moreover, we are interested in structure‑preserving numerical methods that are particularly adapted to the physical structure of the modeling equations, as well as in hybrid methods that couple models of different complexity for optimal efficiency. We are participating in the Collaborative Research Center on “Cosmic Interacting Matter” and are therefore especially interested in plasma‑physics applications in astrophysical environments as well as in magnetic‑confinement fusion. Recently, we have also turned to the Wetterich equation, an exact equation of the functional renormalization group, providing a systematic framework to study many‑body and field‑theoretic models such as classical and quantum phase transitions in solid‑state physics.

As a research assistant (m/f/x), you will independently develop new numerical schemes, implement and test their properties as well as analyze their numerical properties in challenging application problems. The opportunity to pursue further academic qualifications (a Ph.D.) is offered and encouraged.

Scope: part-time
Duration: fixed-term, 36
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-10-13

Your tasks:

- Research in scientific computing with the focus on the development and efficient implementation of numerical methods for hyperbolic differential equation
- Implementation of efficient algorithms for application problems
- Writing of papers for publication in highly ranked international journals
- Teaching in applied mathematics

The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Thus, it contributes to the improvement of the prevention, early diagnosis, and therapy of diseases like cardiovascular diseases or cancer. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.
